reconcile.note: Clarke reads Luke's 'hate' as a Hebraic idiom equivalent to Matthew's 'loves more than me,' so it does not cancel the command to honor parents.

discrepancy.emptyNote: E. P. Sanders catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: E. P. Sanders, Jesus and Judaism (1985).
